summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by iAnthus Capital Holdings, Inc. reporting items 5.07 (Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders) and 8.01 (Other Events) related to its 2026 annual general meeting held on June 25, 2026. The filing discloses the voting results for director elections (five nominees elected) and the re-appointment of auditor PKF O'Connor Davies, LLP. No special situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is present. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 merely repeats the meeting results. This is an ordinary routine current report with no special-situations content.
